<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2102-42-42" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3810">gangs pa</rs> na re lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid ni mi mthun pa'i rgyu 'bras zhes pa'am 'gal ba'i rgyu 'bras su gnas pa yin no zhes 'dod pa dang |
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> na re dngos po gnyis [(p.281)]<lb n="281.1"/> la gnas pa'i chos gnod bya gnod byed kyi rang bzhin yin no zer ba dang |
         yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo btsun</rs> na re rdzas kyi rgyun bzlog bya zlog byed du 'dug pa zhes pa la bzhed de|_tshogs pa mtshan nyid du 'dod pa ni mi srid la | kha yar ba mtshan nyid du 'god pa phan tshun ma khyab pas de rnams ni ma yin no ||</seg></TEI>
